faqs.question: Are dentures uncomfortable to wear?
faqs.answer: Modern dentures are designed for comfort, but initial adjustments may be needed as you get used to them.

faqs.question: How long do dentures last?
faqs.answer: With proper care, dentures can last 5-10 years. Regular checkups are essential to maintain their fit.

faqs.question: Can I eat normally with dentures?
faqs.answer: Yes, although it may take some time to adapt. Start with soft foods and gradually return to your normal diet.

faqs.question: Do dentures affect speech?
faqs.answer: You may experience slight difficulty initially, but practice and adjustments will help you speak normally.

faqs.question: Can I sleep with my dentures in?
faqs.answer: It is recommended to remove dentures at night to give your gums a rest and maintain oral hygiene.
